name: INK Editor
tagline: INK Editor combines AI writing assistance with real-time SEO optimisation. As users write, the AI scores content against top-ranking pages and suggests keywords, structure, and length improvements. It also includes an AI co-writer for generating paragraphs, headlines, and meta descriptions.
